details.description: Qwen2.5-14B is a 14.7-billion-parameter base (pretrained, non-instruction-tuned) language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released September 2024 as part of the Qwen2.5 series. Qwen's model card states long-context support up to 128K tokens and generation up to 8K tokens, with support for over 29 languages. As a base model it is intended as a foundation for fine-tuning or continued pretraining rather than direct conversational use; Fireworks AI's hosted listing for it confirms it is the base variant, distinct from the separate Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct model.
advantages: Supports long-context input up to 128K tokens, per Qwen's own model card (Hugging Face model card).
Reports a score of 63.69 on MMLU-Pro (Hugging Face model card).
Qwen states support for multilingual text in over 29 languages, including Chinese, English, French, Spanish, German, Japanese, Korean, Arabic and Vietnamese (Hugging Face model card).
disadvantages: Base pretrained model without instruction or chat tuning, so it is not designed to follow chat-style instructions directly (Hugging Face model card).
Fireworks AI's hosted model listing states this model does not support function calling or image input on that platform.
use_cases: Foundation for supervised fine-tuning or continued pretraining into a task-specific or chat model
Long-context document and code processing up to 128K tokens
Few-shot text completion and in-context learning tasks

notes: Catalog facts give this URI's max_input_tokens as 131,072, which matches Qwen's stated 128K-token context length exactly (128 x 1024 = 131,072) and the model's own config.json (max_position_embeddings: 131072), so there is no real conflict there despite the different-looking numbers. The catalog's max_output_tokens of 131,072 does conflict with Qwen's stated generation cap of 8K (8,192) tokens; kept the catalog's figure per instructions and flag that mismatch here. Fireworks AI's hosted listing for 'qwen2p5-14b' (no '-instruct' suffix) confirms this is the base, non-instruction-tuned Qwen2.5-14B model, consistent with the slug and separate from Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. No source found stating this base model has been superseded. Language support is described only as a partial named list plus a ~29-language count, not a complete enumeration, so languages was left empty.
